text: 你的威胁让查理动摇了。她不愿白干一场，于是当晚趁守夜时偷偷离开，带走独木舟和一份补给作为报酬。几小时内，诺曼和西尔维娅都不敢直视你的眼睛。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 599
text: Your threat impressed Charlie. Rather than end up with nothing for her efforts, she sneaks off that night during her watch, taking the canoe and a share of the supplies as payment. Norman and Sylvia cannot meet your eyes for a few hours.
